name: Realtivo-Resales Online for Houzez
author: Realtivo

sections.description:
Connect the Houzez theme with Resales Online to import live property listings. Easy setup. No coding. Free to use.

Key Features:
* Manual and automatic property import from Resales Online API
* Real-time property updates via scheduled cron jobs
* Comprehensive API data management with “Api Data” custom post type
* Advanced search functionality – search through first page or all properties across all pages
* Property ID/Reference search across entire property database
* Detailed import logs with status tracking, duration, and property counts
* Search Type and Property Count display for each filter
* Auto-refresh API data functionality
* Sophisticated property data display with filtering and sorting
* Support for multiple filter IDs
* Property image handling with CDN integration

Features

Property Import:
* Manual import with progress tracking
* Automatic daily property updates via cron
* Support for multiple filter IDs
* Configurable property import limits
* Duplicate detection and handling

API Data Management:
* “Api Data” custom post type for viewing API responses
* Displays total property count from all pages (not just first page)
* Shows Search Type for each filter
* Last updated timestamp tracking
* One-click refresh to fetch latest API data
* Auto-creation of data posts for each configured filter ID

Search Functionality:
* Search through first 40 properties (fast, client-side filtering)
* Search ALL properties across all pages (AJAX-powered, searches entire database)
* Property ID/Reference search with exact and partial matching
* General property search (location, description, etc.)
* Sort by Reference, Price, or Bedrooms
* Real-time search results with highlighted matches

Import Logs:
* Detailed logging of all import operations
* Status tracking (Running, Completed)
* Property count tracking (updated, inserted)
* Duration calculation for each import
* Start and end time recording
* Sortable columns for easy log management

Property Management:
* Automatic property image handling
* Property location mapping
* Custom field mapping (community fees, IBI, garbage tax, etc.)
* Featured property support
* Property status management

External Services

This plugin uses the Resales Online API to fetch real estate property listings.

  • Service Used: Resales Online API
  • Purpose: Displaying updated real estate listings in your WordPress site.
  • Data Sent: API credentials (p1, p2), agency ID, property reference, api Key and Filter IDs.
  • When: Whenever the plugin syncs property data or loads listings.
  • Terms: Privacy Policy | Terms of Use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Property Importer” in your admin dashboard and configure your Resales Online API credentials.
  4. Set up your Filter IDs (comma-separated) in the Import Settings page.
  5. Use “Import Properties” to manually import properties or wait for automatic updates.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Resales Online account?

Yes, you’ll need an active Resales Online account with API credentials (Identifier and API Key) to fetch property data.

Is this plugin free to use?

Absolutely! The plugin itself is free.

Does it work with other themes?

This version is designed specifically for the Houzez theme.

How do I search for a specific property?

You can search in two ways:
1. Quick Search: Use the search boxes on the Api Data page to search through the first 40 displayed properties (instant results).
2. Search All Pages: Use the “Search All Pages” feature to search through all properties across all API pages. Enter the Property ID or Reference and click “Search All Pages”.

What is the difference between “Properties” count and total properties?

The “Properties” column shows the total PropertyCount from the API (e.g., 5,954 properties). The displayed properties grid shows only the first page (typically 40 properties) for performance. Use “Search All Pages” to find any property from the full database.

How often are properties updated?

Properties are automatically updated daily via a scheduled cron job that runs at midnight. You can also manually trigger updates or use the refresh button in the Api Data section.

What are Filter IDs?

Filter IDs are identifiers from your Resales Online account that define which properties to import. You can configure multiple Filter IDs (comma-separated) to import properties from different sources or categories.

How do I view import logs?

Navigate to “Property Importer > Logs” in your WordPress admin. You’ll see all import operations with status, duration, property counts, and timestamps.

Can I limit how many properties are imported?

Yes, you can set a “Limit Properties” value in the Import Settings. This limits the total number of properties imported across all filters.
